mapper.sql: record_id, user_id, type_id, type_name, plan_seconds, actual_seconds, calories, exercise_date, start_time, end_time, status, abandon_reason, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exercise_record ( record_id, user_id, type_id, type_name, plan_seconds, actual_seconds, calories, exercise_date, start_time, end_time, status, abandon_reason, remark, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{recordId}, #{userId}, #{typeId}, #{typeName}, #{planSeconds}, #{actualSeconds}, #{calories}, #{exerciseDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{abandonReason}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE exercise_record SET actual_seconds = #{actualSeconds}, calories = #{calories}, status = #{status}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
UPDATE exercise_record SET abandon_reason = #{abandonReason}, status = #{status}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exercise_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM exercise_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date = #{exerciseDate} ORDER BY start_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_seconds), 0) FROM exercise_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND exercise_date = #{exerciseDate} AND status = 2
